title: The value of solitude
idea: Schopenhauer argued that you can only be fully yourself when alone, and that a person with a rich inner life needs others less.
apply: Block one solo hour a week for something you choose, without an audience or a screen.
remind: Protect time alone. It is where you become yourself.
who: Hana, who is rarely alone and rarely herself.

scenes.nar: Hana's week is full. Work, then drinks, then weekend plans, and a group chat that never closes.
She notices she cannot say what she actually likes. She agrees with whoever is nearby, and feels tired without knowing why.
Schopenhauer argued you can only be fully yourself when alone. So Hana books one hour a week, phone away, doing something only she chose.
Two months in, she has taken up watercolor, said no to two plans, and feels more like herself.
